evidence: The ZnO ﬁlm grown at 100°C showed XRD patterns and SEM image similar to the ﬁlm grown at 100°C, but it has too high a carrier density, 3.1 × 10 21 cm−3. It seemed very difﬁcult to obtain well-behaved TFT characteristics with this carrier density. Thus, we tried to reduce the amount of carrier in the ZnO active layer by lowering the growth temperature down to 100°C and reducing the ﬁlm thickness, and succeeded in obtaining TFT performance.
